title: Smart Ski Goggles
summary: My friend and I spotted a pair of AR ski goggles on Shark Tank, and were excited to order them until we saw the price tag of $350. We set about making our own version, which could either be in a custom 3D-printed format or retrofitted into any pair of goggles (which we almost immediately realized was a better idea). The difficulty came with the harsh environment the electronics would be subjected to and the small form factor. The AR effect was created with an OLED screen and a laminate on the goggles themselves, all powered by a custom PCB I slaved away for hours to create, and spent even more hours trying to fix.
